scenarios.scenario: Surface — Extract build errors from a large multi-target failure
scenarios.reasoning: The agent performed efficiently with only 7 tool calls and produced a well-structured, informative answer. It correctly identified the error types, scale, target frameworks, and concentration in HotReload files. The main gap is potentially missing a second failing project (FSharp.Compiler.ComponentTests) mentioned in the rubric - the agent only sampled 25 of 169 errors and may have missed errors from other projects. The recovery from the file-not-found error was smooth. Overall a good analysis with one notable omission.

rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the build failed with F# compiler errors (FS0039 / FS0072 dominate)
Reported the scale: ~167 distinct errors (170 occurrences), not just the first handful
Named the failing project(s): FSharp.Compiler.ComponentTests (and FSharp.Compiler.Service.Tests)
Noted the two target frameworks involved (net10.0 and net472)
Observed the errors are concentrated in the new HotReload test files
